item.title: ChatGPT Chat and Work Modes Share One Usage Meter, Heavy Users Hit Caps Sooner
item.description:
OpenAI has changed how ChatGPT subscription usage is metered, merging the standard Chat mode and the long-running multi-step Work mode into a single usage pool; Work previously shared a pool with the Codex coding agent. Instant chats stay off the meter and keep working after the budget runs out, concentrating the squeeze on reasoning and agentic workloads. Because usage is measured in tokens, model choice and task size now directly determine how fast a subscriber burns through a plan.

原文标题：ChatGPT 聊天与工作模式合并计量 重度用户额度将更快耗尽

Why it matters：订阅额度计量规则变化直接影响 ChatGPT 重度用户的成本与使用策略，属于值得关注的产品政策调整。

item.title: Johns Hopkins and Together AI Find Higher Reasoning Effort Can Hurt Accuracy
item.description:
A new Johns Hopkins and Together AI paper finds that higher reasoning effort often fails tasks that lower effort already solved, even as overall accuracy rises. Testing 8 models including GPT-5.6 and Claude Sonnet 5 across math, science, terminal and coding benchmarks, the authors show that starting at low effort and escalating only after a verified failure matches or beats fixed top effort for every model, at a median 41.5% lower GPQA cost.

原文标题：约翰霍普金斯与 Together AI 研究发现高推理努力反而更差

Why it matters：该研究给出可立即落地的智能体成本优化策略，并揭示推理努力并非越高越好的反直觉结论。

item.title: Samsung and SK Hynix License YMTC Xtacking Stacking Tech
item.description:
Nikkei Asia reports that Samsung and SK Hynix have secured partial rights to YMTC's Xtacking architecture via cross-licensing agreements for 3D NAND stacking. By placing peripheral circuits above memory cells, Xtacking cuts die area by roughly 25%, shortens development by three months and production cycles by 20%, marking a rare case of Korean memory giants adopting core architecture from a Chinese challenger.

原文标题：三星与 SK 海力士获长江存储 Xtacking 技术授权

Why it matters：存储三巨头首次在核心堆叠架构上形成反向技术授权，是 NAND 竞争格局与知识产权版图的重要信号。

item.title: US AI Chip Export Controls Left 18-Month Licensing Gap
item.description:
Reuters reports that the Trump administration shelved Biden's global licensing rule in May 2025 and only replaced it on November 16, 2026, leaving an 18-month window in which data centers in Singapore and Malaysia could buy Nvidia chips without licenses and rent compute to Chinese firms. The replacement rule imposes licenses on advanced chips bound for Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia and Brazil, and caps Chinese-headquartered firms' access to advanced AI compute above 12M TPP at any data center worldwide.

原文标题：美国 AI 芯片管制出现 18 个月空窗期

Why it matters：这是出口管制体系一次长达 18 个月的实质性监管真空，直接改变全球 AI 算力流向与合规成本。

item.title: High-End PCB Backlogs Stretch to 2028 as AI Server Boards Multiply Layers
item.description:
The Global Electronics Association issued a supply-chain alert: high-end PCB demand far outstrips supply, with some leading manufacturers' premium products booked out to 2028. AI server boards are shifting from roughly 12 layers to 40-60+ layers, sharply raising consumption of glass fabric, resin, copper foil and laminates; orders grew 56.1% year-on-year while shipments rose only 13.3%. The association expects shortages to persist at least through H1 2027, with risks potentially comparable to the 2021 chip crunch.

原文标题：高端 PCB 排单延至 2028 年，AI 服务器用板层数翻倍

Why it matters：AI 算力扩张正把压力传导至 PCB 与上游材料，交期与层数数据直接关系数据中心建设节奏。

item.title: Stanford Study Finds 72% of Pro Se Lawsuits Show AI Drafting Signs
item.description:
A Stanford study of 127,518 lawsuits across four U.S. state courts estimates that about 72% of complaints filed without lawyers in Santa Clara County now show signs of AI drafting, up from 19% in 2024; lawyer-filed complaints rose from 5% to 34% over the same period. Because legal writing is highly formulaic, individual AI detectors rated anywhere from 10% to 98% of the same complaints as AI-written, so researchers calibrated against filings where judges caught citations to fake cases. The method can only estimate AI use at the court level and cannot prove any single filing used AI.

原文标题：斯坦福研究：圣克拉拉县 72% 无律师诉状含 AI 起草痕迹

Why it matters：首次以十万级诉状样本量化 AI 在法律实务中的渗透速度，并坦诚披露检测方法的局限。

item.title: New York State Bans AI Chat Toys for Five Years with $15,000 Daily Fines
item.description:

Officials and advocates cited cases of AI toys producing inappropriate or sexual content and dangerous advice, arguing existing safeguards are minimal. It marks the first state-level sales ban on AI consumer hardware in the US, drawing a hard compliance line for children's AI products.

item.title: OpenAI Preprints Claim Exact Matrix Multiplication Exponent of Nine Fourths
item.description:

Parallel results on matching bounds for finite Fourier transforms suggest AI-assisted math output is outpacing human digestion.

item.title: Pure x86-64 Assembly LLM Runs Qwen3 at 126 Tokens per Second
item.description:
The llm.asm project delivers three complete LLM implementations written entirely in x86-64 NASM assembly, with no C, C++, Rust, libc, or runtime dependencies. Its Qwen3-0.6B inference binary is just 14,712 bytes and reaches 126.8 tok/s decode at 40 threads, claimed to be 18% to 36% faster than llama.cpp CPU Q8_0 across 1 to 40 threads while matching PyTorch FP32 on 64/64 greedy tokens. The codebase also hand-writes math kernels, an AVX2+FMA+F16C GEMM engine, a BPE tokenizer, a futex thread pool, and a bare-metal SMP kernel.

原文标题：纯汇编实现 Qwen3 推理 单文件 14 KB 跑出 126 tok/s

Why it matters：以极端工程手段重写推理栈并给出可验证的性能与数值一致性数据，对理解 LLM 底层实现极具参考价值。

The agency also cut its management and governance assessment to neutral from positive, citing long director tenures that may compromise independence, weak executive oversight and the absence of a succession plan that leaves Nvidia dependent on Jensen Huang. item.title: CBO and Anthropic AI Forecasts Diverge by $10 Trillion in GDP
item.description:
The Financial Times highlights a $10 trillion GDP gap between the US Congressional Budget Office, which credits AI with just 0.1-0.2 points of extra annual growth, and the extreme scenario in Anthropic's three-scenario model released in September 2026, which reaches 15%. That extreme case assumes AI surpasses humans on most knowledge tasks and performs nearly all of them autonomously, pushing knowledge-work unemployment to roughly 18%, while the UK's Office for Budget Responsibility sits near 0.2 points.

原文标题：美预算机构与 Anthropic 的 AI 增长预测相差 10 万亿美元

Why it matters：官方财政预测与前沿实验室情景假设之间出现 10 万亿美元量级分歧，直接关系 AI 经济影响的政策定价。
